notes.title: ⚔️ Enter the Shadows ⚔️
notes.content:
[p]🕯️ Dear Witch Hunters, 🗡️[/p][p]It’s time to lift the veil a little...[/p][p]We’ve been working deep in the shadows to bring you something special:[/p][p]the first Multiplayer Demo of Beware of the Witch is coming. ⚔️🧪[/p][p]Soon, you'll have the chance to enter the cursed valley yourselves,[/p][p]to explore, to fight, and to survive. 🌫️🩸
[/p][p]We know it’s been quiet for a while.[/p][p]Game development isn’t always loud – sometimes it's just long nights, broken builds, and stubborn monsters that don’t behave. 🐛💀[/p][p]But trust us: we’ve been busy crafting a world worth your time. One that listens to your torchlight. One that reacts. One that haunts.[/p][p]
This first demo will be more than just a sneak peek:[/p][p]🎯 It’s your chance to test the core mechanics[/p][p]🧭 Shape the future of the game with your feedback[/p][p]🕷️ Help us hunt down bugs, balance chaos, and refine the darkness[/p][p]
We’re also working on sharing more frequent updates 📝 – little glimpses behind the scenes, sneak peeks of characters, enemies, and environments.[/p][p]Because this hunt... is something we want to walk together with you.[/p][p]
So sharpen your blades. Check your lantern oil.[/p][p]And never trust a shadow. 🐺[/p][p]
Your Witch Hunt Team 🌲🔥[/p]

notes.title: Witchhunter's Arsenal
notes.content:
The witchhunter's arsenal is his most vital tool – a perfect blend of steel, precision, and ancient craftsmanship. Each weapon is forged to hunt the darkness and strike fear into those who dare defy the light.

notes.title: Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257968/2f117aa197c22bd06e8f106b81c9150cf508a807.png[/img]
We're thrilled to announce that Dear Brother: Beware of the Witch has officially launched on Kickstarter! 

This is your chance to join us on this magical journey, helping us bring the game to life while getting access to some amazing exclusive rewards. From behind-the-scenes content to limited-edition game content, there’s something for every fan.

By backing our project, you're not just funding a game—you’re becoming part of a growing community passionate about immersive storytelling, unforgettable characters, and thrilling gameplay.

But we need your help to spread the word! Share our Kickstarter campaign with your friends, family, and fellow gamers. Together, we can reach our goal and make Dear Brother: Beware of the Witch everything we’ve dreamed of—and more!

👉 Check out our campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dearbrother/dear-brother-beware-of-the-witch?ref=4kmqsy]Kickstarter[/url]

Kickstarter special: [b]Everyone who supports us with Kickstarter gets a mention in the game credits.
[/b]
Thank you for your support, and let’s make this journey magical! ✨
